column1: Welcome to the Pain Regulation Task!
Please relax and remain still during the experiment while we record your brain activity.
In this task, you will perform three pain regulation techniques: observe, facilitate, and inhibit.\n\nBefore each trial, an on screen instruction will explain how to perform the technique.
During each regulation period, you will rate your current pain level on a scale from 0 (no pain) to 10 (worst possible pain).\n\nYou may adjust your rating at any time if your pain changes.

Each technique will be completed five times, followed by a confidence rating where you indicate how well you feel you performed the technique.\n\nThere will be a 60 second break between each technique block.
The state measure will begin on the following screen.\n\nPlease let us know if you have any remaining questions.
